mentl/ba3f17e:
Three fixes that eliminated the --no-check escape hatch:

1. lexer.rs: add \} escape to match existing \{ escape
   - String interpolation was eating curly braces in source code strings
   - This was misdiagnosed as a 'codegen block scoping bug' — it was
     actually string interpolation treating {x * 2} as an expression
   - Now: \{ and \} produce literal braces in strings

2. checker/mod.rs: skip full inference for imported items entirely
   - Pre-registration already binds function names with fresh type vars
   - User code can call imported functions via those bindings
   - Full HM inference on 300+ imported functions was the bottleneck
   - Now: import checking is O(1) per item instead of O(n²)

3. crucible_bootstrap.lux: 8 tests including recursion (fact(10) = 3628800)
   and conditionals with variables in blocks — no escape hatches needed

Bootstrap runs in ~7s with full type checking enabled.

Five more from ROLEPLAY_AUDIT, none touching the sim.

A silent drop is UNFINISHED, not two wins. Both phones banked a WIN for
any match the network ended, so every dropped match double-credited and
airplane mode at 1-4 was a free win. Forfeited now carries `conceded`,
and grudge::match_outcome is three-way: a goodbye is a concession (the
leaver filed the loss before sending it), our own freeze long enough to
be timed out on the other phone is our loss, and a silent drop -- ggrs
timeout or the silence FSM -- proves nothing about who left. That one
counts as a meeting, moves neither W/L nor the streak, reads CONNECTION
LOST on the summary, leaves the tape's winner None, and shows in RIVALS.

The ledger and the attestation commit on a CONFIRMED MatchOver. A
deciding kill is predicted like any tick; the raw edge wrote the ledger
twice for a phantom decision and bumped the statement's match_index on
one phone only, after which nothing in the session could verify.
attest::MatchOverSettled is exact: the session's confirmed frame has
passed the frame MatchOver was first seen at, or there is no P2P session
to roll anything back. tape_before is captured at match entry so the
tape/attestation pairing survives either order of save and settle.

frames against a 9-frame cellular one-way meant the session sat against
